1879060972.name: Dust in the Eyes
1879060972.desc: Blind enemies in front of you, dazing them momentarily and leaving their movements hampered.

1879073004.name: Wild Attack
1879073004.desc: A powerful melee attack, followed by a quick off-hand swipe.

1879073516.name: Upper-cut
1879073516.desc: You make a stiff punch at your enemy.

1879166828.name: Passage of Shadow
1879166828.desc: Allows you to track the presence of the dead, the unseen, and ancient evil.

1879198316.name: Friend of Sturdy Beasts (Polar Bear)
1879198316.desc: Summons a bear companion.\n\nBears are tough companions which can draw the ire of the enemy.

1879201260.name: Improved Mandible Strike
1879201260.desc: Using its powerful mandibles, your hatchling delivers a devastating blow.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>Critical hits disarm the target.</rgb>

1879228140.name: Battle Preparation
1879228140.desc: Allows the Warden to build Gambits before starting a fight.

1879233004.name: Javelin and Shield
1879233004.desc: Capable Wardens prepare their javelin and shield for attack.

1879240556.name: Arise
1879240556.desc: Your steed is able to dig deep for something extra and instantly restores its power and fury.

1879240812.name: a mounted unarmed attack
1879240812.desc: Auto-attack when not wielding a weapon in the primary hand.

1879250028.name: Rohan's Edge
1879250028.desc: A powerful attack, further enhanced when landing a critical strike that will cause your next attack to inspire you and your nearby fellowship members.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>After scoring a critical with Rohan's Edge, your next skill-based attack will increase the damage dealt by you, your fellowship members and war-steeds within 40 metres for 10 seconds.</rgb>

1879262956.name: By The Right Flank
1879262956.desc: Your target cannot deny your threats and will close in on you to flank your side. You can take this opportunity to break its armour and will.

1879270508.name: Blinding Upshot
1879270508.desc: This attack does additional Light damage for each point of Focus consumed.

1879272556.name: Rapid Chicken Hit
1879272556.desc: Quick short hits will do the trick.

1879274092.name: Snap Shot - Hampering Javelin
1879274092.desc: Javelins can pierce body parts or equipment and slow the target until the javelin can be removed.

1879316844.name: Execute
1879316844.desc: Consume remaining Wrath to deal a massive amount of damage. Places a mitigation buff on the Beorning.

1879368172.name: Friend of Sturdy Beasts (Aurochs)
1879368172.desc: Summons an aurochs companion.\n\nAurochs are tough companions which can draw the ire of the enemy.

1879387116.name: Travelling Goat of the Mountain Meadow
1879387116.desc: A goat dressed to celebrate spring.

1879400044.name: Present-bearing Pet Pony
1879400044.desc: Brings out a friendly pony bearing gifts to help you celebrate the season.

1879418604.name: Adventurous Lurker
1879418604.desc: Summons a lurker to accompany you on any adventure.

1879439340.name: Stormhammer's Wrath
1879439340.desc: Hermáth Stormhammer executes a deadly whirling attack with Theneb-adhâr, the Thunderstrike, damaging and debilitating nearby foes.

1879449836.name: Vicious Claws: Claw (Dual)
1879449836.desc: A savage attack that deals damage to your enemy, interrupting their action.\n\nDeals increased damage.

1879458540.name: Defensive Strike
1879458540.desc: You attack defensively, entering a Battle-readied state.

1879470572.name: The Field of Celebrant
1879470572.desc: Sing of the Field of Celebrant.

1879491564.name: Air Lore
1879491564.desc: Air continually swirls around your target ally, inflicting damage on any who strike it.\n\nCannot be used on self.

1879494124.name: Guise of Saruman
1879494124.desc: A finely-crafted costume in the guise of Saruman of Many Colours. Truly, an outfit for every occasion!

1879495276.name: Memory of Fellowship
1879495276.desc: A Memory of Fellowship can be used to inspire your allies, reminding them of their bonds and helping them to resist evil.

1879497708.name: Sign of the Wild: Protection
1879497708.desc: Command your pet to use a defensive ability, prioritizing survival above all else.

1879507820.name: Perforate
1879507820.desc: A Critical hit enables the Burglar to strike with both weapons.\n\n<rgb=#FFFF00>Dual-wielding required.</rgb>

1879521260.name: Raspberry Slime
1879521260.desc: Summons a delicious raspberry slime to accompany you on your travels.

1879521388.name: Rust Slime
1879521388.desc: Summons a rust slime to accompany you on your travels.

1879528812.name: Prepare: Frost-spike
1879528812.desc: A spike of ice strikes a target. You are covered in an icy shell helping to avoid some damage.
